title.narrative: Operating clinics of the King Salman Center for Relief and Humanitarian Aid in Zaatari camp in Jordan

description.narrative: Improving access to comprehensive primary healthcare services for men, women, youth, and children with high-quality, efficient, and equitable access to secondary medical services (specialty) for men, women, youth, and children with high-quality, efficient, and equitable access to medical activities and diagnostic and therapeutic procedures to ensure transparency and inclusion of stakeholders.Governing administrative systems (operations management, logistics, procurement, etc.) for KSrelief clinics.Providing support services that contribute to the provision of high-quality and efficient services.

Improving the health status of Syrian refugees residing in Zaatari Camp by providing comprehensive, integrated, high-quality, and equitable primary and secondary healthcare services for all age groups.

Manage and operate King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center (KSrelief) clinics in accordance with the laws and regulations of the Jordanian Ministry of Health, ensuring workflow is conducted in accordance with local and international protocols.
